programme.title: Answered by Fire
programme.desc: Set against the tumultuous lead-up to the 1999 referendum in East Timor and its horrifying aftermath, ANSWERED BY FIRE is a very personal exploration of first-world intervention in third-world traumas. Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. But when the UN evacuates in the post-ballot rampage, Mark and Zoe are forced to abandon Ismenio and his family to a nightmarish fate. Haunted by guilt, the two westerners each find their way back to Timor, driven to make amends to the people they tried - and failed - to protect.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin leaves the Australian mainland to discover which of the island-dwelling animals is truly built to survive. First up, he meets the enigmatic green turtle on the Wellesley Islands. Next, he is on K'Gari (Fraser Island), where he tracks down a pack of the notorious dingoes. Finally, he encounters the formidable and aptly named death adder snake.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads to the mysterious blue depths to discover which animal dominates the sea. His first encounter is with a tiger shark, the notorious hunter shaped like a torpedo and armed with ferocious teeth! Next, Phil dives with a group of magnificent manta rays and listens to the songs of one of the largest creatures on Earth, the majestic humpback whale.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: A national Geographic documentary looking into the deadliest animals that roam Africa. Examining animals that have evolved complex weapons from teeth to claws and agility so that they can protect themselves and battle effectively. Showing how these animals have exceptional skills and power alongside their body features that have developed into ideal tools for their needs.

programme.title: Wild Mississippi
programme.desc: North America's most famous waterway, the Mississippi River, is explored in this fantastic documentary series, focussing on the vast numbers of animals that depend on it for survival. With stunning cinematography that highlights its beauty and size, Wild Mississippi reveals the diverse climates and landscapes this enormous waterway covers, with its basin stretching for thousands of miles. A three-part series, each episode focusses on a unique aspect of the river, whether it's the cold, frozen birth as it falls south from the northern states, the floods it causes, both beneficial and detrimental to animals and humans alike, as well as its negative effects, such as the masses of fertiliser it carries into the Gulf of Mexico.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol Compilations
programme.desc: There's not much that Dr. Jan Pol hasn't seen throughout his long, veterinarian career. The Dutch-born veterinarian has been helping animals since he graduated from Utrecht University in 1970. In this series we look back at memorable moments from his reality series, The Incredible Dr. Pol, where alongside his employees and his family he helps nurse a variety of creatures back to health from his Michigan-based practice. His clients come in all shapes and sizes, often needing urgent medical assistance, something that Dr. Jan Pol lives for. The passionate veterinarian is always keen to help, and we revisit the original series' greatest moments.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Lions kill four buffaloes in a stampede, while in another drying river a buffalo fights off five of the big cats. As the dry winter looms, heading out on a game drive means checking in at all the remaining waterholes. This is where the action plays out. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos. The hippos take on a group of male lions. A honey badger battles for life against leopards, and wild dogs cause chaos everywhere they go! In the wilds of Southern Africa, the long, dry winter brings a desperation to the animals who live here. Prepare yourself for a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: When the savannah turns into a battleground, it's hard to choose a hero. We're on the edge of our safari seats as a leopard is cornered by a pride of lions, a young impala is hurled into the air by a hippo and two hyenas try to drown each other. Then, the rarest of sightings as an Aardvark runs for its life from a brown hyaena. Who will win when it's tooth versus claw?

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: In this true story, lion researcher Dr. Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival in one of the world's most unforgiving environments, Namibia's deadly Skeleton Coast. He gets up close and personal to unlock secrets of their world and witness the amazing adaptability of these special cats.

programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. programme.title: Lake Tanganyika: Africa's Blue Heart
programme.desc: Lake Tanganyika, one of the largest lakes on earth combines two very different yet equally magical worlds: an untouched wilderness along the shores, home to chimpanzees, elephants and antelopes and a spectacularly diverse underwater universe. The lake shares many of the ocean's characteristics. Glorious sunsets, occasional storms with terrifying waves and waters filled with sardines, colorful fish, crabs and even sponges.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm

But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year's hay haul. They hope for sun, so their crop doesn't spoil before they can bale. Meanwhile, the Pol's bring in their next animal to the farm - an emu!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's the county fair season! The Pol's plan to get at least two cows and six sheep at the auction, but they have a lot to do before that can happen. First up, they must install a new perimeter fence. Charles and Ben think they are off to a good start, but when Dr. Pol points out how sneaky sheep can be, their workload doubles. Meanwhile, Beth is hoping for a goat at the small animal auction.

programme.title: Lake Tanganyika: Africa's Blue Heart
programme.desc: Lake Tanganyika, one of the largest lakes on earth combines two very different yet equally magical worlds: an untouched wilderness along the shores, home to chimpanzees, elephants and antelopes and a spectacularly diverse underwater universe. programme.title: Africa's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: A land full of extreme environments and teeming with iconic wildlife, Africa holds a fascination like no other continent. This series takes the viewer on a journey from harsh desert landscapes to towering peaks, and from vast, sprawling grasslands to raging river torrents. The three episodes cover the mist-covered jungles and mountains of Rwanda and the great apes who call it home; the largest desert in the world, the Sahara, where the scarcity of water and food make life a daily challenge for the creatures who compete for them; and the cradle of humanity, Ethiopia, a weather-ravaged land full of natural beauty and unique wildlife.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm

At the auction, the Pol's are hoping to purchase sheep and cows, but the skyrocketing bids threaten their big plans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The bidding is live at the large animal auction! The Pol's are working towards their goal of bringing home sheep and cows to their farm. Any animals they win will be delivered to the farm in just three days, so the pressure is on to get the sheep hut finished in time - and there is a ton left to do. Meanwhile, Beth and Charles are concerned about the low activity in their beehives.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: She haunts the trees and hills in the heart of the realm. She is solitary, silent and virtually invisible. Saba the leopard is a killer without rival. Saba is the most spectacular and resourceful hunter the Savage Kingdom has seen. Her stronghold, Leopard Rock, sits at the heart of this brutal realm it is a place where she can vanish into the shadows and avoid running into her rivals lions, hyenas and wild dogs. There is no question that Saba the leopard can take care of herself, but her strength and resilience will be cruelly tested when she tries to bring two cubs into the realm where only she can protect and feed them in the midst of the cauldron of warring predators. The ordeal will tear at her heart.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: It is pure luck to have a genie to fulfill all wishes, to have two of them is something incredible. Leah is a little girl with a genie bottle necklace, which includes Shimmer and Shine, genie twins. Shimmer is a genie with blue eyes and pink hair, encouraging and passionate, she has a pet, a gibbon monkey Tala. Shine is her twin genie with purple eyes and blue hair, big animal lover. Her pet is a little Bengal tiger Nahal. Zac is Leah's neighbor with red hair and blue eyes, and her best human friend. Leah is making three wishes every day, genies are doing their best but the results are far from perfect, as genies are very young and unskilled. This is the source of awkward and comic situations, but in the end girls manage to get over all difficulties.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.desc: Rusty Rivets is a fantastic and picturesque animated series about Rusty who lives in Sparkton Hills along with his friend Ruby Ramirez, a robotic tyrannosaurid named Botasaur, and a group of smaller robots known as the Bits. Rusty is a smart inventor and a little genius who with the help of his amazing discoveries helps his friends out of difficulties. Rusty constructs robots of different sizes, forms and purposes, he is in love with science, technology and engineering. Together with his friend Ruby they can repair any old machinery and out-of-date equipment. Their splendid intellect arouses envy and toxic rivals do not play the game clean.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: Kamp Koral

All other characters such as Mr. Krabs, Mrs. Puff, SpongeBob's nemesis Plankton, and Karen are a part of this adventure as well.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks hinges on David Seville, a single father whose everyday struggle is to bring up his kids, 3 chipmunks: Alvin- the oldest brother, the leader, not so good at school, Simon- the smartest of the three brothers, exemplary pupil and Theodore- the youngest one, the chubby one, the gentle one. David "Dave" sometimes loses his temper and then he is shouting "Alvinnnnn!!!". Music is an obligatory pleasant part of every episode. Every episode touches up-to-date issues of both adults and kids from modern life like real problems at school, dating and so on. Thanks to their own foolishness chipmunks often find themselves in ridiculous situations and have to use their creativity to get out of a mess, that provides us with a good opportunity to enjoy their joyful adventures.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.desc: Il primo film della figlia d'arte Caitlin Cronenberg è una satira distopica con Jay Baruchel. La Terra è sull’orlo del collasso quando una cena di famiglia finisce nel caos.

programme.title: Tutti tranne te
programme.desc: Sydney Sweeney e Glen Powell in una maliziosa commedia romantica. Bea e Ben passano insieme una notte esplosiva prima che le loro strade si dividano. Alcuni mesi dopo, il destino provvede a farli reincontrare in occasione di un matrimonio. Le cose sono cambiate ma a loro conviene fingere di essere una coppia per placare un ex asfissiante e per ingelosire una nuova fiamma.

programme.title: Indiana Jones e il regno del teschio di cristallo
programme.desc: Il grande ritorno di Harrison Ford nel quarto capitolo con Cate Blanchett e Shia LaBeouf. Pedinato dai sovietici Indy deve ritrovare una reliquia dai poteri soprannaturali.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: L'action che ha consacrato Tom Cruise. Un pilota di caccia va in crisi quando causa la morte di un amico. Ne uscira' grazie a una donna. Oscar e Golden Globe per la migliore canzone.

programme.title: Pacific Rim - La rivolta
programme.desc: Il ribelle Jake Pentecost è un promettente pilota di Jaeger. Insieme a sua sorella, sono chiamati a guidare la nuova generazione di combattenti con il compito di sconfiggere i mostri Kaiju, intenzionati a distruggere l'umanità.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Will Smith e Tommy Lee Jones nel secondo capitolo della saga fanta-action. Una malvagia aliena vuole impossessarsi di una potentissima pietra. Ma gli agenti J e K sono pronti a fermarla.

programme.desc: Ultimo capitolo della saga di Christopher Nolan con Christian Bale, Anne Hathaway, Marion Cotillard e Gary Oldman. Batman interrompe l'esilio per sventare il piano di un terrorista.

programme.title: Indiana Jones e il regno del teschio di cristallo
programme.desc: Il grande ritorno di Harrison Ford nel quarto capitolo con Cate Blanchett e Shia LaBeouf. Pedinato dai sovietici Indy deve ritrovare una reliquia dai poteri soprannaturali.

programme.title: Paradise Highway
programme.desc: Thriller on the road con Juliette Binoche, Frank Grillo e Morgan Freeman. Per aiutare il fratello in carcere una donna contrabbanda merci, ma l'ultima consegna si rivela diversa.

Le cose sono cambiate ma a loro conviene fingere di essere una coppia per placare un ex asfissiante e per ingelosire una nuova fiamma.

programme.title: Il gladiatore II
programme.desc: Ridley Scott dirige Paul Mescal e Denzel Washington nell'atteso sequel del suo film leggendario. Anni dopo la morte di Marco Aurelio, suo nipote Lucio, ridotto in schiavitù, combatte per vendicare la morte della sua sposa e mettere fine alla tirannia di Caracalla e Geta.

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Spettacolare blockbuster di Guillermo Del Toro con Idris Elba e Charlie Hunnam. Due coraggiosi piloti devono salvare il destino del pianeta Terra, minacciato da gigantesche creature aliene.

programme.title: Pacific Rim - La rivolta
programme.desc: Il ribelle Jake Pentecost è un promettente pilota di Jaeger. Insieme a sua sorella, sono chiamati a guidare la nuova generazione di combattenti con il compito di sconfiggere i mostri Kaiju, intenzionati a distruggere l'umanità.

programme.title: C'era una volta il crimine
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della saga di Massimiliano Bruno, con Marco Giallini, Gianmarco Tognazzi, Giampaolo Morelli ed Edoardo Leo. La banda viaggia fino al 1943 per rubare la Gioconda ai francesi.

programme.title: La musica nel cuore - August Rush
programme.desc: Freddie Highmore e Robin Williams in un film toccante e magico. Il piccolo August, prodigio della musica, suona per le strade di New York sperando di rintracciare i suoi genitori.

programme.title: Il cavaliere oscuro - Il ritorno
programme.desc: Ultimo capitolo della saga di Christopher Nolan con Christian Bale, Anne Hathaway, Marion Cotillard e Gary Oldman. Batman interrompe l'esilio per sventare il piano di un terrorista.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Io sono la fine...
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci portano alla scoperta del film di Angelo Duro acclamato dal pubblico, dal 10 giugno in programmazione su Sky Cinema.

programme.title: La sfida delle mogli
programme.desc: Peter Cattaneo ("Full Monty") dirige un biopic al femminile con Kristin Scott Thomas. Per sopportare l'assenza dei mariti in missione in Afghanistan, alcune donne formano un coro musicale.

programme.title: Era mio figlio (2024)
programme.desc: Richard Gere e Diane Kruger in una pellicola sul rimpianto di Savi Gabizon. Un ricco magnate scopre di aver avuto un figlio, morto in un incidente, e decide di scavare nel suo passato.

programme.title: La zona d'interesse
programme.desc: Premio a Cannes e 2 Oscar per l'intensa opera di Jonathan Glazer. Un solo muro separa la quiete borghese della famiglia del comandante di Auschwitz dal campo di concentramento.
3 Oscar al capolavoro bellico di Sam Mendes con George MacKay e un grande cast. Due soldati inglesi sono incaricati di portare in territorio nemico un messaggio che salverebbe molte vite.

programme.title: Radioactive
programme.desc: Rosamund Pike, Sam Riley e Anya Taylor-Joy nella biografia di Marie Curie. La vita della scienziata polacca, naturalizzata francese, che ha cambiato il mondo con le sue scoperte, salendo in cattedra in una società dominata dagli uomini e aggiudicandosi per due volte il Nobel.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sette Oscar e un Golden Globe al film di fantascienza di Alfonso Cuaron, con Sandra Bullock e George Clooney. La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.title: Fuga da Alcatraz
programme.desc: Cult assoluto del cinema carcerario diretto da Don Siegel. Clint Eastwood è un detenuto in fuga dall'inespugnabile penitenziario di Alcatraz, amministrato da un sadico aguzzino.

programme.title: Joker
programme.desc: Oscar a Joaquin Phoenix e Leone d'oro a Venezia per la genesi del nemico di Batman. Frustrato dagli insuccessi personali e professionali, Arthur Fleck si trasforma in un crudele criminale.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: 6 Oscar per il capolavoro di Kathryn Bigelow con Jeremy Renner protagonista. In Iraq, una squadra di artificieri statunitensi viene inviata sul posto per una pericolosa missione.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Un immenso Jim Carrey nella sconvolgente metafora dei nostri tempi. Dal giorno della nascita, a sua insaputa, Truman vive sorvegliato dalle telecamere nel piu' estremo dei reality show.

programme.title: Povere creature!
programme.desc: Londra XIX secolo: una donna morta suicida nel Tamigi viene riportata in vita da uno scienziato. Bramosa di conoscere e totalmente libera, la rediviva creatura inizia un instancabile percorso di formazione e di emancipazione.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: 6 Oscar per il capolavoro di Kathryn Bigelow con Jeremy Renner protagonista. In Iraq, una squadra di artificieri statunitensi viene inviata sul posto per una pericolosa missione.

programme.title: Marcello mio
programme.desc: Chiara Mastroianni, attrice e figlia d'arte di Marcello Mastroianni e Catherine Deneuve, e il regista Christophe Honore' confezionano un ritratto del grande attore, in concorso a Cannes.

programme.title: Fuga da Alcatraz

programme.title: Frida
programme.desc: 2 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe alla biografia della pittrice messicana Frida Kahlo, con Salma Hayek. Una vita scandita da relazioni controverse e incontri cruciali con personaggi storici.

programme.title: Joker
programme.desc: Oscar a Joaquin Phoenix e Leone d'oro a Venezia per la genesi del nemico di Batman. Frustrato dagli insuccessi personali e professionali, Arthur Fleck si trasforma in un crudele criminale.

programme.title: The Company Men
programme.desc: Dramma sociale con Ben Affleck, Kevin Costner e Tommy Lee Jones. La vita di un agiato impiegato americano subisce un netto ridimensionamento quando perde il lavoro a causa della Recessione.

programme.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
programme.desc: Monumentale opera di Martin Scorsese con Leonardo DiCaprio e Robert De Niro. Una misteriosa serie di omicidi tra i nativi americani Osage obbliga il governo a intervenire.

programme.title: The Blues Brothers
programme.desc: John Belushi e Dan Aykroyd nell'irriverente commedia musicale di John Landis. Per salvare l'orfanotrofio in cui sono cresciuti, due fratelli riuniscono la loro band per un concerto.

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca
programme.desc: John Cena e Brian Cox nella pellicola targata Sky Original. Una giovane giornalista scopre una cospirazione che coinvolge un candidato alla Presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Salvate il soldato Ryan
programme.desc: 5 Oscar per il film di guerra firmato Steven Spielberg, con Tom Hanks e Matt Damon. Dopo lo sbarco in Normandia, un plotone va in cerca dell'unico soldato superstite di quattro fratelli.

programme.title: Campo di battaglia
programme.desc: Alessandro Borghi e Gabriel Montesi nel film di Gianni Amelio. Durante la Grande Guerra e l’epidemia di febbre spagnola l’amicizia tra 2 medici è minata dal diverso approccio etico.

programme.title: Nel nostro cielo un rombo di tuono
programme.desc: Riccardo Milani dirige un docu-film biografico sul campione Gigi Riva. Dall'infanzia alla gloria, la vita e la carriera del grande calciatore e il suo forte legame con la Sardegna.

programme.title: Per niente al mondo
programme.desc: Guido Caprino prova a riprendere in mano la sua vita nel film di Ciro D'Emilio. La vita di Bernardo cambia drasticamente quando viene incarcerato con l'accusa di associazione a delinquere.

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca
programme.desc: John Cena e Brian Cox nella pellicola targata Sky Original. Una giovane giornalista scopre una cospirazione che coinvolge un candidato alla Presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Michael Gracey confeziona un originale biopic su Robbie Williams, rappresentato sullo schermo da una scimmia: da timido bambino diventerà una pop star internazionale.

programme.title: The Blues Brothers
programme.desc: John Belushi e Dan Aykroyd nell'irriverente commedia musicale di John Landis. Per salvare l'orfanotrofio in cui sono cresciuti, due fratelli riuniscono la loro band per un concerto.

programme.title: Qui rido io
programme.desc: Toni Servillo interpreta Eduardo Scarpetta nel biopic di Mario Martone premiato con 2 David di Donatello 2022. La storia dell'attore napoletano da cui sono nati i tre fratelli De Filippo.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: 2 Oscar alla pellicola di Ron Howard con Tom Hanks sulla sfortunata missione spaziale. 1970: il viaggio verso la Luna della navicella Apollo 13 viene interrotto da un'esplosione.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Leonora addio
programme.desc: Paolo Taviani omaggia Pirandello in un film premiato a Berlino. Dopo la morte dello scrittore, un emissario comunale intraprende un viaggio da Roma ad Agrigento per trasportarne le ceneri.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Da una storia vera, thriller di David Fincher con Jake Gyllenhaal, Mark Ruffalo e Robert Downey Jr. San Francisco, 1969: un inafferrabile serial killer sfida la polizia e la stampa.

programme.title: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
programme.desc: Ricatti e omicidi in un thriller con Val Kilmer, Robert Downey Jr e Michelle Monaghan. Una serie di coincidenze porta un ladro a recitare in un film. Finirà in un torbido giro.

programme.title: La teoria del tutto
programme.desc: Oscar a Eddie Redmayne, al fianco di Felicity Jones nel biopic sullo scienziato Stephen Hawking: una vita segnata dalla malattia, dalla scienza e dall'insuperabile amore per la moglie Jane.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: 2 Oscar alla pellicola di Ron Howard con Tom Hanks sulla sfortunata missione spaziale. 1970: il viaggio verso la Luna della navicella Apollo 13 viene interrotto da un'esplosione.

programme.title: Hurricane - Il grido dell'innocenza
programme.desc: Un magnifico Denzel Washington nella travolgente biografia di Rubin "Hurricane" Carter. All'apice della carriera, il celebre pugile viene accusato ingiustamente di omicidio.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Mrs Lowry & Son
programme.desc: Timothy Spall e Vanessa Redgrave nella biografia del pittore britannico L. S. Lowry. Figlio di una donna che scoraggia quotidianamente le sue ambizioni, l’aspirante artista lavora ogni giorno con l’obiettivo di dipingere un quadro che possa rendere la madre fiera di lui.

programme.title: Penguin Bloom
programme.desc: Naomi Watts e Andrew Lincoln in un'emozionante storia vera. Paralizzata a causa di un incidente, una donna trova il coraggio di ricominciare prendendosi cura di una gazza ferita.

programme.title: Conclave
programme.desc: Un Oscar e un Golden Globe all'acclamato film di Edward Berger ambientato nel mondo della Chiesa con Ralph Fiennes, Stanley Tucci, Sergio Castellitto e Isabella Rossellini.

programme.title: Ladyhawke
programme.desc: Cult immortale con Rutger Hauer e Michelle Pfeiffer in una struggente fiaba d'amore. Il diabolico sortilegio di un uomo malvagio nega l'amore fra una donna e un cavaliere.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Gran Premio della Giuria a Cannes per Spike Lee e Oscar alla sceneggiatura. Un poliziotto afroamericano si infiltra nel Ku Klux Klan per indagare sul razzismo nell'America degli anni 70.

programme.title: The Apprentice - Alle origini di Trump
programme.desc: Sebastian Stan è l’imprenditore e Presidente USA nel biopic di Ali Abbasi. New York, anni 70: l'ascesa del magnate segnata dall'incontro con l'avvocato Roy Cohn (Jeremy Strong).

programme.title: Giu' la testa
programme.desc: Western restaurato di Sergio Leone con James Coburn e Rod Steiger. Un fuorilegge messicano si allea con un rapinatore irlandese e si trova a combattere per la Rivoluzione di Villa e Zapata.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - E allora zumba!
programme.desc: Un nuovo caso a Pineta nella 21esima storia della produzione Sky Original. Mentre tutti sono occupati, l'omicidio della pediatra getta nel panico un papa' iper ansioso come Beppe.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Il pozzo dei desideri
programme.desc: 22esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Un morto in un pozzo dà il via all’estate con un caso per la Fusco, uno sfratto per Massimo, Tizi e Beppe e un guaio per Pasquali.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La girata
programme.desc: Nuove indagini nel 23esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Durante una battuta di caccia tra amici ci scappa il morto. Un incidente? Solo la Fusco e Massimo sapranno darci una risposta.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Sopra la panca
programme.desc: 24esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original con i protagonisti del BarLume. Mentre il padre di Tiziana sparisce all'improvviso, un cadavere trovato in mare fa partire una nuova indagine.

programme.title: I delitti del Barlume - Non e' un paese per bimbi
programme.desc: Si torna a indagare nel 25esimo film targato Sky Original. Gino è sparito e sulle sue tracce c’è una coppia improbabile coinvolta in un traffico di diamanti.

programme.title: I delitti del Barlume - Gatte da pelare
programme.desc: 26esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original. Mentre la Fusco è a caccia della Rusic, Cioni e Govoni cercano di risolvere un caso da soli mettendo in difficoltà Pasquali.

programme.title: I delitti del Barlume - Sasso carta forbici
programme.desc: 27esimo film ambientato a Pineta. A un passo dall’uscita della sua hit, Marchino scopre il cadavere della sua agente mentre i bimbi trovano un video hot di Pasquali.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Il re dei giochi
programme.desc: Giallo e risate nella prima commedia targata Sky Cinema tratta dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Un incidente d'auto scatena le fantasie investigative di Massimo e degli arzilli vecchietti.

programme.desc: Seconda commedia con Filippo Timi, tratta dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Il mistero sul passaggio di proprieta' di un terreno innesca una catena d'eventi e una nuova indagine.

Quando un pauroso incendio avvolge l'edificio, Sawyer viene ritenuto ingiustamente responsabile dell'accaduto ed e' costretto a fuggire. Ma nel grattacielo ci sono sua moglie e i suoi bambini. programme.desc: Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Carice van Houten e Guy Pearce in un thriller di Brian De Palma. Due agenti di Copenaghen, sulle tracce di un killer, vengono coinvolti in un intrigo internazionale.

programme.desc: Naomie Harris e Natalie Dormer, una delle star de "Il Trono di Spade", in un intricato thriller psicologico dalla suspense serrata. Stufa di subire le prepotenze del marito, Heather ricontatta dopo molti anni una ex compagna di scuola per proporle di uccidere l'uomo.

programme.desc: Prodotto da Michael Bay, un thriller che immagina un drammatico futuro. 2024: le continue mutazioni del Covid-19 hanno chiuso il mondo in un eterno lockdown. programme.desc: Morgan Freeman e Ashley Judd in un thriller dal romanzo di James Patterson. La nipote del criminologo Alex Cross e' scomparsa. Le indagini conducono al folle piano di uno psicopatico.

programme.desc: Grande successo nelle sale per il film diretto e interpretato da Marco D'Amore che racconta la storia personale di Ciro di Marzio, uno dei grandi protagonisti di 'Gomorra - La serie'.

programme.desc: Commedia sentimentale con Renee Zellweger. Inviata a supervisionare una fabbrica in Minnesota, Lucy supera l'ostilita' della comunita' locale, vivendo un'esperienza ricca di sorprese.

programme.desc: Diane Lane e John Cusack in una romantica commedia sui cuori solitari. Una quarantenne divorziata viene spinta dalle sorelle a incontrare uomini conosciuti sul web, con effetti esilaranti.

programme.desc: Emozionante film Sky Original di e con Edoardo Leo affiancato da Marta Nieto, Claudia Gerini e Stefano Fresi. Due coppie affrontano il momento più delicato della loro lunga vita insieme.

programme.desc: Emilia Clarke e Henry Golding in una romantica commedia scandita dalle canzoni di George Michael. Londra: Kate sbarca il lunario lavorando in un negozio durante il periodo natalizio, mentre coltiva il sogno di diventare una cantante. L’incontro con Tom cambierà la sua vita.

programme.desc: Esilarante commedia di Max Bruno con Paola Cortellesi, Raoul Bova, Rocco Papaleo e Anna Foglietta. Dopo la morte del marito, una donna decide di diventare una escort per pagare i debiti (ITA 2011).

programme.desc: Sharon Stone in una pellicola di Pupi Avati con Riccardo Scamarcio. Dopo il suicidio del padre scrittore, il figlio tenta di pubblicarne il libro incompiuto scoprendo scottanti verita'.

programme.title: Sposa in rosso
programme.desc: Sarah Felberbaum ed Eduardo Noriega in una commedia di Gianni Costantino, tra Malta e la Puglia. Due sconosciuti organizzano un finto matrimonio per intascare i soldi dei regali di nozze.

programme.title: Io rimango qui
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Frank Pope, un drammatico e coraggioso inno alla vita. La sedicenne Steffi scopre di essere gravemente malata, ma rifiuta le cure per partire a bordo del suo pick up in un viaggio avventuroso verso Parigi insieme a Steve, un ragazzo alla ricerca di se stesso.

programme.title: Se scappi, ti sposo
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Richard Gere di nuovo insieme nella commedia romantica dal regista di "Pretty Woman". Ike Graham e' un cronista di New York in cerca di un'idea per il prossimo pezzo da consegnare al suo capo, la sua ex moglie. Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.title: La casa sul lago del tempo
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves in una love story che trascende lo spazio e il tempo. Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

programme.desc: 8 Oscar al kolossal di Victor Fleming con Clark Gable e Vivian Leigh. Le tormentate vicende di un affascinante avventuriero e di una fiera ereditiera nell'America della Guerra Civile.

programme.desc: Teen-movie paranormale di Scott Speer. L’unione degli innamorati Riley e Chris viene spezzata da un incidente d’auto. Rimasta in vita, Riley si convince che Chris la contatti dall'Aldilà.

programme.desc: Un cast di star hollywoodiane per una commedia sul mistero dell'amore. A ridosso di San Valentino, si intrecciano le storie di coppie innamorate e di single in cerca dell'anima gemella. Persone che si incontrano e si perdono di vista nei modi piu' imprevedibili. Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. Dal regista di "Pretty Woman", il film negli Stati Uniti e' uscito nel giorno di San Valentino, incassando al debutto 57 milioni di dollari.

programme.title: La Febbre
programme.desc: Mario Bettini, un giovane geometra trentenne, si trova a ripensare alla propria vita, particolarmente dopo l'incontro con una ballerina.

programme.title: Via col vento
programme.desc: 8 Oscar al kolossal di Victor Fleming con Clark Gable e Vivian Leigh. Le tormentate vicende di un affascinante avventuriero e di una fiera ereditiera nell'America della Guerra Civile.

programme.desc: Sydney Sweeney e Glen Powell in una maliziosa commedia romantica. Bea e Ben passano insieme una notte esplosiva prima che le loro strade si dividano. Alcuni mesi dopo, il destino provvede a farli reincontrare in occasione di un matrimonio. Le cose sono cambiate ma a loro conviene fingere di essere una coppia per placare un ex asfissiante e per ingelosire una nuova fiamma.

programme.desc: Tre Oscar e un Golden Globe per un intramontabile classico della commedia con Gregory Peck e Audrey Hepburn, premiata con l'Oscar al suo primo ruolo da protagonista. La principessa Anna giunge a Roma per una visita ufficiale. Nella Capitale incontra un reporter americano, sull'orlo del licenziamento, che le propone una 'vacanza alternativa', lontano dai rigidi e noiosi cerimoniali del protocollo. Fuggita da palazzo, vivra' una romantica avventura, scoprendo grazie al suo accompagnatore il vero volto della citta'. Ma i giornali sono sulle tracce della principessa e lo scoop e' in agguato...

programme.desc: Love story tratta dal romanzo di Jenny B. Jones. Una brillante violinista, pressata dalle sue stesse ambizioni, decide di trascorrere un semestre di studio in Irlanda. L’incontro con un giovane affascinante divo del cinema la porterà a comprendere la vera natura dei suoi sogni.

programme.title: Vicino all’orizzonte
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di Jessica Koch, un teen-movie ispirato a una storia vera con Luna Wedler e Jannik Schumann. Un oscuro segreto rende impossibile il legame fra Jessica e l'affascinante Danny.

programme.desc: Commedia natalizia Sky Original con Freida Pinto e Iwan Rheon. In cerca di un successo natalizio per la sua boy band, una manager trova un brano perfetto, scritto da un musicista metal.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume 11 - Speciale
programme.desc: I registi insieme ai protagonisti del BarLume danno voce a un divertente racconto del dietro le quinte delle nuove storie de "I delitti del BarLume".

programme.title: La Febbre
programme.desc: Mario Bettini, un giovane geometra trentenne, si trova a ripensare alla propria vita, particolarmente dopo l'incontro con una ballerina.

programme.desc: Franck Dubosc e Alexandra Lamy in una commedia romantica. Jocelyn, dongiovanni impenitente, non si ferma davanti a niente quando vuole sedurre una donna. Egoista e bugiardo, finge di essere disabile per conquistare la bella Marie. La messa in scena del playboy si complica pero' quando la donna gli presenta sua sorella Florence, la quale e' costretta veramente a vivere su una sedia a rotelle. Jocelyn dovra' fare i conti con un aspetto da lui sempre trascurato, il sentimento, quello che inizia a provare per Florence. Diretto dallo stesso Franck Dubosc, al suo esordio dietro la macchina da presa.

programme.title: La rivolta delle ex
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Jennifer Garner in una commedia romantica dal tocco soprannaturale. Connor Mead è un celebre fotografo che ha un enorme fascino sulle donne: nessuna riesce a resistergli, e lui da cinico playboy passa da un'avventura all'altra. Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Nel cast, anche Michael Douglas.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: Richard Gere e Jennifer Lopez per una commedia romantica a passo di danza. Lui e' un avvocato di successo con una bella famiglia ma si sente infelice. Lei e' l'insegnante di ballo che potrebbe aiutarlo a colmare il suo vuoto interiore.

programme.desc: Dall'omonima serie tv di grande successo, i sofisticati intrighi della famiglia Crawley. Gli aristocratici padroni di casa si mobilitano per l'imminente visita dei reali d’Inghilterra.

programme.title: Due partite
programme.desc: Commedia dolce-amara sul mondo femminile con un cast di stelle italiane. Anni 60: quattro amiche si incontrano per confidarsi. Trent'anni dopo è la volta delle loro figlie.

programme.title: La rivolta delle ex
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Jennifer Garner in una commedia romantica dal tocco soprannaturale. Connor Mead è un celebre fotografo che ha un enorme fascino sulle donne: nessuna riesce a resistergli, e lui da cinico playboy passa da un'avventura all'altra. Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Luciano, padre di Leo, vive ancora in Calabria ed e' attaccato alle radici rurali della famiglia. Luigi e Rocco, invece, si sono arricchiti al nord: il primo come narcotrafficante, il secondo entrando nel mondo dell'imprenditoria grazie a un giro di soldi sporchi. La provocazione di Leo li costringera' a un sanguinoso regolamento di conti con il passato.

Ultimately, Jin foregoes his ceremony and instead delivers Morty’s five babies.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Already stretched thin between responsibilities, Yi discovers one of Morty’s babies still in her building. She’s going to need help from Jin and Peng to find Mini-Morty and return the baby creature to her mother.

programme.title: Sesame Street S54
programme.desc: Elmo, Tamir, Charlie, Julia, and Cookie Monster are making self-portraits in the community garden with Kayla. Kayla guides them to look into the mirror and notice the beautiful things that make you, you! Everyone looks at themselves in the mirror and starts drawing what they see. They also learn their identity is about what you love to do. So, they add onto their self-portraits and then share their drawings with each other. Cookie Monster draws his blue fur, his googly eyes, and cookies. Charlie draws her blue eyes, curly blonde hair, tap shoes, and challah bread because it’s one of her favorite Jewish foods. Julia draws her straight hair, musical notes, paw prints, and her dog Rose. Elmo draws his red fur, orange nose, a piano, and watering a flower with Abby because being a kind neighbor is part of Elmo’s identity. Tamir draws his brown skin, coily hair, comic books, and some veggies as he loves gardening in the community garden. There are so many special things that make you, you!

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service
programme.desc: Pat must deliver eggs, milk, flour and butter to Greendale for the annual Pancake Race. But when Michael mixes all the ingredients together, Pat finds that he instead has to deal with a mixing bowl full to the brim with pancake mix... Meanwhile in Greendale, Sara's attempts at pancake-tossing aren't going well and she soon loses her pancake under the wheels of PC Selby's car. Even worse, Ted Glen's amazing Pancake Machine has run out of mix so Sara won't be able to run the race unless Pat can get to Greendale on time... But Pat gets waylaid by Alf's cows and the pancake mix ends up all over the road. Pat hurries back to Pencaster but Michael now only has butter and flour so Pat has to go and get eggs from Nisha and even some milk from Rosie the goat! With the race about to start, Pat arrives just in time with all the ingredients necessary for Ted to make Sara a fresh pancake. SDS Mission accomplished!

programme.desc: Join May J. for great Japanese music! This week: cool R\u0026B-rooted J-pop from girl duo Natsudaidai; and EDM-influenced rock from THE SIXTH LIE. Both acts are in the J-MELO studio to chat and perform.

programme.title: Little Charo
programme.desc: Little Charo is an animation series about a Japanese dog who got lost in NY. \"I want to see my owner again!\" Charo starts his adventure back home. Season 1-18.

programme.desc: Japanology Plus explores Japanese life and culture. In this 5-minute digest, we look at the significance of cats in Japan.

programme.title: A Cat's-Eye View of Japan

The Carbonaro Effect S2 8
programme.desc: Filling in as a karate instructor, Michael disrupts the Zen of his student with skills that literally lift him off the ground, and at a toy store, Michael's frog necklace is so fashionably realistic that it has one little girl begging for a new pet. Then at a military outfitting store, Michael and an employee put together a clothing display that puts the \"man\" in mannequin.

programme.title: The Carbonaro Effect S2 9
programme.desc: Michael works at a camping store where his life-saving s'mores and pop-up coolers stun would-be glampers, and later at a health food store, a child safety pill bottle with built-in invisibility proves too complicated for adults. Then, at variety store, a customer goes off the rails when Michael adjusts the size of a model train.

programme.title: The Carbonaro Effect S2 10
programme.desc: Michael befuddles a hardware store patron with a collapsible spray paint can, and cuts a costume shop employee down to size when he shrinks into a leprechaun outfit. Later, a museum employee makes the discovery of a lifetime when a preserved egg hatches a baby dinosaur.

programme.title: The Carbonaro Effect S2 11
programme.desc: Tonight, Michael tries to pull a fast one on burger joint patrons with his inflatable hot dogs and his unusual technique for bagging buns. Then he creeps out a flea market vendor when he brings an acrylic encased arachnid back to life, and later his co-worker doesn't give a hoot about her job at the camping store when an owl takes over their display.

programme.title: The Carbonaro Effect S2 12
programme.desc: Michael hits the jackpot at a convenience store and amazes a mother when he demonstrates her child's genius abilities at a toy store. Later, MIchael astonishes his Japanese restaurant co-worker with a set-up that really takes the cake.

programme.title: The Carbonaro Effect S2 13
programme.desc: Michael leaves a co-worker out to dry at the garden center with a technologically confounding hose that wirelessly transmits water. Later, at the dog groomers, Michael's puppy takes to the catwalk after dressing himself in the most fashionable canine attire.

programme.title: Smallville S1 10
programme.desc: A teenage girl, Amy Palmer, lets her obsession with Lex become life threatening as attacks in the Luthor mansion pit Clark against an invisible enemy.

programme.title: Magnum Force
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Clint Eastwood stars as San Francisco Police Inspector Harry Callahan better known as \"Dirty Harry\" because of the tough way he pursues criminals in this bare-knuckled action film. Investigating the assassinations of crime bosses, Dirty Harry discovers the killers are police who, frustrated by the judicial system, have vowed to rid the city of crime by any means--even killing fellow police officers.

programme.title: The West Wing S1 14
programme.desc: The President contemplates commuting a federal sentence.

programme.title: Friends S5 9
programme.desc: Ross becomes upset when someone at work takes his sandwich from the refrigerator and eats it. Joey finds himself in a terrible mess when he tries to cover for Chandler and Monica's dating.

programme.title: Friends S5 10
programme.desc: Phoebe collects money for the Salvation Army during the holidays. A bored Ross creates havoc in Joey and Chandler's lives. Rachel is disturbed by her date's inappropriate relationship with his sister.

programme.title: Friends S5 11
programme.desc: The friends all make New Year's resolutions, but it looks like Rachel's resolution – to stop gossiping – is going to be the hardest to keep when she finds out about Chandler and Monica's dating.

programme.title: Friends S5 12
programme.desc: Chandler's behavior toward his boss annoys Monica. Ross' latest romance astounds everyone.

programme.title: The West Wing S1 14
programme.desc: The President contemplates commuting a federal sentence.

programme.title: Justice League (2017)
programme.desc: Fueled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists the help of his newfound ally, Diana Prince, to face an even greater enemy. Together, Batman and Wonder Woman work quickly to find and recruit a team of metahumans to stand against this newly awakened threat. But despite the formation of this unprecedented league of heroes – Batman, Wonder Woman, Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash – it may already be too late to save the planet from an assault of catastrophic proportions.

programme.title: Collateral Damage
programme.desc: Firefighter Gordon Brewer, is done putting out fires and ready to start one of his own. When his wife and child are horrifically killed in an international terrorist bombing -- linked to Claudio \"The Wolf\" Perrini -- the CIA and FBI offer no answers and no response. With the official investigation going nowhere, and haunted by the thought of his family's killer walking away scot-free, Gordon swears revenge, even if it takes him to Colombia.

programme.title: Smallville S1 10
programme.desc: A teenage girl, Amy Palmer, lets her obsession with Lex become life threatening as attacks in the Luthor mansion pit Clark against an invisible enemy.

programme.title: Friends S5 13
programme.desc: Phoebe meets her father at her grandmother's funeral. Chandler discovers that Monica gives bad massages. Rachel dresses Joey for an audition. complete with a man's shoulder bag.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S6 13
programme.desc: Leonard's car is stolen when the guys take a road trip to a comic book convention in Bakersfield, dressed as Star Trek characters.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S6 14
programme.desc: Outraged that he’s being forced to work with university nemesis, Barry Kripke, Sheldon faces a crisis of conscience. Howard and Raj spend a thousand dollars on action figures of themselves.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S6 15
programme.desc: A fight between Leonard and Sheldon drives Leonard to finally move in with Penny – not realizing how the shift will affect Penny and Amy’s living arrangements.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S6 16
programme.desc: While the guys try to give their significant others the perfect Valentine’s Day, Raj and Stuart throw a lonely people party at the comic book store.

programme.title: Arrow S2 20
programme.desc: Oliver and the team return to the lair and find Slade waiting for them. An epic battle breaks out and Oliver is faced with a choice - his battle with Slade or his family.

programme.title: Arrow S2 21
programme.desc: After the Mirakuru sends Roy into an uncontrollable rage and he unleashes on the city, Oliver realizes it's taken over completely, and he must figure out a way to stop him.

programme.title: Arrow S2 22
programme.desc: After Slade threatens to take away everything Oliver loves, Oliver decides the fastest way to stop further bloodshed is to surrender - an option that will lead to his death.

programme.title: Arrow S2 23
programme.desc: As Slade's soldiers attack the city, Oliver rallies his team and Felicity gets a call from S.T.A.R. Labs with game-changing news. Thea comes face to face with Malcolm Merlyn.

programme.title: Arrow S2 24
programme.desc: In the Season Two Finale, Oliver must decide once and for all whether he's a killer or a hero when Slade moves forward with his plan to kill one more person in Oliver's life.

programme.title: Elysium
programme.desc: Pada tahun 2154, orang kaya menghuni sebuah stasiun ruang angkasa dan orang miskin tinggal di planet Bumi. Seorang pria menjalankan misi untuk membawa kesetaraan bagi dunia nan bertolak belakang tersebut.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Penemuan Blade Runner K muda tentang sebuah rahasia yang telah lama terkubur menuntunnya untuk menemukan mantan Blade Runner terdahulu, Rick Deckard, yang telah menghilang selama tiga puluh tahun.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: Sebuah kasus pembunuhan di Louvre dan sejumlah petunjuk di lukisan-lukisan karya Da Vinci membantu menguak sebuah misteri keagamaan yang telah dilindungi oleh suatu kelompok rahasia selama 2.000 tahun.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Tom Hanks kembali berperan sebagai pakar simbologi, Robert Langdon, yang harus memecahkan misteri pembunuhan dan mengungkap rencana suatu kelompok kuno untuk meledakkan Vatikan.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Seorang pengusaha mengundang tim ahli untuk mengunjungi taman miliknya yang dihuni dinosaurus hasil kloning. Namun, putusnya listrik membuat dinosaurus lepas dan mengancam nyawa semua orang, termasuk cucu-cucunya.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Penemuan Blade Runner K muda tentang sebuah rahasia yang telah lama terkubur menuntunnya untuk menemukan mantan Blade Runner terdahulu, Rick Deckard, yang telah menghilang selama tiga puluh tahun.

programme.title: City Of Ember
programme.desc: Penduduk Kota Ember telah berkembang pesat di dunia yang dipenuhi cahaya gemerlap. Namun, generator Ember yang dulunya sangat kuat mulai rusak dan lampu-lampu besar yang menerangi kota mulai berkedip-kedip.

programme.title: The Karate Kid 3
programme.desc: John Kreese, yang dikucilkan dan tak memiliki uang, berupaya membalas dendam pada Daniel dan Miyagi dengan bantuan temannya saat Perang Vietnam yang merupakan pemilik bisnis pembuangan limbah beracun yang kaya raya.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Tom Hanks kembali berperan sebagai pakar simbologi, Robert Langdon, yang harus memecahkan misteri pembunuhan dan mengungkap rencana suatu kelompok kuno untuk meledakkan Vatikan.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Ketika seorang gembong mengancam kota New York, sekelompok pasukan kura-kura mutan akhirnya muncul dari persembunyian untuk melindungi tempat tinggal mereka.

programme.title: TMNT: Out Of The Shadows
programme.desc: Para kura-kura ninja mutan bekerjasama dengan Casey Jones untuk menyelamatkan dunia dari rencana buruk Shredder sang penjahat super dan menghadapi musuh terbesar mereka, Krang.

programme.title: Dead Man Down
programme.desc: Seorang pria yang hampir mati mengejar bos mafia asal Eropa Timur yang membunuh istri dan putrinya dengan menyusup ke geng dan membunuh mereka satu per satu, sambil meninggalkan jejak sebagai peringatan kedatangannya.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Dua polisi asal Miami harus menemukan sejumlah heroin senilai 100 juta dolar dalam waktu 72 jam. Namun, bagaimana mereka akan melakukannya? Dibintangi oleh Will Smith dan Martin Lawrence.

programme.title: Bad Boys 2
programme.desc: Dua detektif narkotika, Mike Lowrey dan Marcus Burnett, berhasil mengungkap sebuah konspirasi yang melibatkan seorang gembong narkoba yang bertekad mengambil alih perdagangan narkotika yang sedang berkembang di kota.

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: Sebuah prekuel yang berfokus pada kisah pertemuan James T. Kirk muda dan Tn. Spock di Akademi Starfleet beserta misi luar angkasa pertama mereka.

programme.desc: Setelah sang ayah wafat, Britt Reid mewarisi perusahaan ayahnya. Ia bekerja sama dengan mantan asisten sang ayah, Kato, untuk menjadi tim pemberantas kejahatan bertopeng.

programme.title: Avengers: Black Widow &...
programme.desc: Saat The Punisher menguak sebuah rencana serangan teroris, ia diminta untuk bekerjasama dengan Black Widow untuk menghentikan kelompok teroris Leviathan.

programme.desc: Tomoya helps out a man in a jam and later discovers he is a retired musician.

programme.desc: Tomoya feeds Youhei bread from Nagisa's family bakery for help in bringing back the drama club.

programme.desc: Nagisa's family helps Fuko with carving more starfish out of wood.

programme.title: Clannad

programme.sub-title: The Wind That Vanishes Into Dusk

programme.desc: Tomoya falls asleep at school only to be awaken by Kotomi playing the violin.

programme.title: Clannad

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya Kanie, a handsome, scholastically successful and athletic high school student, freaks out when his classmate, Isuzu Sento, points a musket at him and demands he take her on a date to an amusement park.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya must accept the reality of his situation after learning that residents of the magic nation of Maple Land operate the park and receiving the ability to hear people's minds by its owner, Queen Latifah.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Circumstances land Seiya the position of acting owner for the park; he proposes reforms to meet the goal of attracting 250,000 visitors within three months, but the crew has a lot of complaints.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Though arrogant, Seiya solves problem after problem at the park; Isuzu wants to be happy about it, but something bothers her.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: With the 30-yen offer, the number of visitors slowly improves, but money remains an issue; attempting to find quick cash, Seiya visits Moffle, and they set off to search for a supposed treasure hidden in a cave.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Isuzu has mixed feelings about Seiya's expert handling of the issues at the park, even having nightmares about her own work; she resolves to fix the labor shortage by interviewing potential hires.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Summer arrives and Splash Ocean, the water park area, buzzes with guests; Isuzu, Muse and the other four fairies wear pirate costumes; Joe the shark notices something wrong in the machine room.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya collapses from fatigue and a cold after busily managing the park for the past few days; Seiya worries about his attendance at school, so Moffle and others pretend to be Seiya by wearing Mogoot Clan's magical clone suit and going to school.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Muse and others practice for a new show, but have trouble coordinating; Latifah decides to host a sukiyaki party to deepen their friendship.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Attendance increases after the park renovates some of the attractions and starts night parades, but Seiya grimly wonders if they can reach the target visitor count before the deadline.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya becomes more determined than ever after finding out Latifah's secret; he comes up with an idea that will help them achieve the target visitor count before the predetermined deadline and orders Tricen, the head of sales, to gather information.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.sub-title: No One Can Predict the Future!
programme.desc: The park sets a new attendance record after being selected as the venue for a soccer match; as visitors file through the entrance gates, Latifah prays for them to achieve the target visitor count; Seiya makes an announcement about the land they sold.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: The staff tries to put together a promotional video to attract more visitors to the park.

programme.title: Modern Times
programme.desc: A factory production line worker is thrown out on the street for his manic behaviour. He then meets a young, homeless girl, who is recently orphaned, and tries to build a home with her.

programme.title: Wonder Woman 1984
programme.desc: Wonder Woman battles Maxwell Lorenzano, an evil businessman, and Barbara Minerva, her friend-turned-foe, who wreak havoc on the world through a wish-granting artefact.
King Leonidas and 300 Spartans fight against Xerxes and his massive Persian army in the battle of Thermopylae. They face insurmountable odds when they are betrayed by a Spartan reject.

programme.title: The World Is Not Enough
programme.desc: James Bond, the renowned secret agent, must protect Elektra King, the daughter of an assassinated billionaire. However, things get complicated when he uncovers a terrorist plot threatening the world.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: A snake hunter offers his assistance to a documentary crew attempting to film an indigenous tribe in the Amazon. But as the journey progresses, his presence forces them to veer into dangerous waters.

programme.title: The LEGO Batman Movie
programme.desc: Batman and friends try to stop Joker from taking over Gotham city while trying to form a relationship with his adopted ward Dick Grayson, who becomes his sidekick.

programme.title: Rush Hour
programme.desc: A detective from Hong Kong and a wisecracking detective from Los Angeles must overcome their differences and work together to find the missing daughter of a Chinese diplomat.

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: James Bond follows Dominic Greene, a prominent developer of green technology, to stop him from aiding a deadly mission to stage a coup in Bolivia.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends decide to spend a weekend in a remote cabin located deep in the forest. When they accidentally summon a dormant demon, they strive to survive its evil ploys.

programme.title: The Starving Games
programme.desc: In a deadly game orchestrated by President Snowballs, skilled archer Kantmiss Evershot, her boyfriend Dale and tech-savvy ally Peter Malarkey must rely on their wits and skills to survive.

programme.title: Wild Card
programme.desc: Nick works as a bodyguard while trying to overcome his gambling addiction. However, his life takes a turn when he learns of a brutal attack on his friend and sets out on a bloody quest for revenge.

programme.title: Land of the Bears
programme.desc: The filmmaker shines a light on the lives of five wild brown bears inhabiting the Kamchatka Peninsula, exploring their daily adventures and activities.

programme.title: DSC
programme.desc: Talented directors provide an entertaining insight into the most intriguing stories and anecdotes concerning some of their best works.

programme.title: Shoulder Arms
programme.desc: Charlie joins a boot camp to become a national hero and gets posted to the front lines in France. He captures 13 Germans and rescues a French girl but later realises that it was just a dream.

programme.title: The November Man
programme.desc: Peter, a former CIA officer, is assigned the task of protecting a valuable witness, Alice, who has secret information about a Russian presidential candidate.

programme.title: Set Up
programme.desc: After his friend betrays him and disappears with the stolen goods, Sonny seeks vengeance. Subsequently, he partners up with a dangerous mob boss to achieve his goal.

programme.title: Vehicle 19
programme.desc: Michael Woods, a traveller and a parolee, picks up the wrong rental car to meet his wife which makes him the prime target of a group of corrupt police officers.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas, a young man, trains under an elder in order to become the keeper of his community's memories. However, things get complicated once he discovers the sinister side of his city.
